thread:
toni: Quick UX review — thinking about integrating the prompt library into the top-left of the playground as a collapsible rail, instead of a slide-over. Makes snippets discoverable but risks cluttering the canvas. Thoughts?

rafa: Collapsible rail could work if it's collapsed by default and reveals on hover/focus. For new users we could show a brief tip tour.

kevin: Concern: rail takes horizontal real estate. For wide-screen devs it's ok but on smaller widths it will push content down. What about hybrid: rail on desktop, slide-over on tablet/mobile?

aria: Accessibility: if it's a rail it still needs aria-expanded and keyboard shortcut to toggle. Also ensure the rail supports drag handles for reorder and a clear accessible label per prompt.

toni: For streaming controls the comp shows inline token badge with a small chevron to expand cost details: tokens, est cost, and time remaining. The expanded panel could include a "compare prompt cost" button that opens the prompt library to show expected costs for snippets.

ops-bot: For telemetry suggest events: playground.prompt.open, playground.token.inspect, playground.prompt.compare. Include properties: prompt_id, response_id, tokens_estimate.

rafa: Small copy nit — replace "time remaining" with "approx. time left" to avoid over-promising accuracy.

kevin: Implementation thought: if user clicks regenerate we should show a brief inline confirmation when the regenerate causes token usage > X% of their session quota. Prevent accidental runaway jobs.

aria: For screen readers when the token panel expands we should set aria-live="polite" and focus the new content so the user hears the numbers. Avoid moving DOM focus unexpectedly though; use a managed focus strategy.

toni: Action items:
- Design: iterate collapsed rail + expanded token detail (toni)
- Dev: responsive pattern (kevin)
- Accessibility: aria-expanded, managed focus (aria)
- Analytics: confirm events + threshold props (ops-bot)

rafa: I'll run a quick a11y pass and test with NVDA/VoiceOver later today.

kevin: I'll stub the quota-warning modal in the regen flow.

toni: If we're aligned I'll pin this comp as "design candidate" and open ticket UI-PL-8230.

aria: :+1:

ops-bot: Created ticket UI-PL-8230 (playground: prompt rail + per-response token expansion + quota regen guard)"
